items.summary: CTO disposition: maintain containment-only execution. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, analytics is unavailable fleet-wide, and existing measurement and repair work remains open. Admit no new site-factory requests, prototypes, reports, research, duplicate proposals, or production changes this cycle. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with root cause, isolated validation, build checks, rollback point, and release-boundary evidence by 2026-10-01T09:00Z; then release one slot. Execute the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement next, preserving destinations, disclosures, accessibility, existing telemetry boundaries, and single-diff rollback. Keep private-launch and security-sensitive release gates unchanged. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, conversion lift, or causal impact.

Reject the proposed routing of three preview-only site-factory change requests. Queue readiness does not override saturated delivery capacity, and preview work still consumes implementation slots. Preserve the existing complicated.work launch packet as waiting; do not create requests for additional sites until a slot is released and launch-readiness evidence is verified.

Reject the new finance evidence-pack proposal for this cycle. Existing revenue and AI-usage evidence remain available, but a report-only request does not address the delivery constraint and would add queue noise. Preserve the existing attribution boundary: the aggregate Amazon row is unattributed, and contribution margin, ROI, and cost-to-learn remain unknown where required inputs are unavailable.
